title: Dietary Flavonols and O-Glycosides | Springer Nature Link
abstract:
Quercetin, kaempferol, myricetin, and isorhamnetin are the major dietary flavonol aglycones, which most commonly occur as O-glycosides in dietary sources including fruits, vegetables, tea, and wine. The role of flavonols and O-glycosides in human nutrition has gained increased interest due to their associated health beneficial effects for a number of chronic diseases, including cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and cancer.
